_comment: Image slots used by the shell. `make assets` (tools/fetch-assets.sh) downloads `url` into ui/assets/fetched/<file> and checks sha256. Leave sha256 empty to record it on the first fetch (trust on first use); commit the recorded value. Without the fetched file the build uses `fallback`, so it never breaks.
